description: Repairing buggy Python functions to an exact written specification: identify the seeded defect in a short function and return a corrected implementation. Judged exclusively by the host function oracle (exact function_io on untouched checks) inside the Linux code sandbox. The teacher is pinned to the exact Ollama cloud tag digest; the evidence class is behavioural_remote (prompt/response only, no internal router or expert claims). Experiment 2 (2026-09-19) expands the TRAINING split only: the six v1 training cases are reused byte-for-byte (their receipted teacher traces remain valid teaching material) plus sixteen newly authored training cases; the development, heldout, final and controls splits are byte-copies of the frozen v1 dataset, verified against the v1 manifest file hashes, so the transfer measurement stays on the untouched frozen evaluation material.

evaluation.training: Authored repair cases whose judged teacher traces may become KD teaching pairs (never any other split); E2 = the six v1 training cases plus sixteen new cases
evaluation.development: Authored repair cases for iterated observation; never teaching material; byte-copy of the frozen v1 development split
evaluation.heldout: Authored repair cases untouched by any teaching decision; the honest transfer measurement; byte-copy of the frozen v1 heldout split
evaluation.final: Authored repair cases frozen at dataset build; NEVER opened in this pilot (final_opened stays false); byte-copy of the frozen v1 final split
